title: Atlantic Blue S.L. - member profile
summary: Association profile of Atlantic Blue stating that the company introduced blueberries to Huelva in 1993, started from four hectares and reached more than 400 hectares in Almonte and Aroche, began a genetic programme in 1995, and holds varieties protected in the European Union and elsewhere.
why_it_matters: Provides an account of the Atlantic Blue breeding programme from a third-party association rather than from its acquirer, and dates the programme to 1995, well before the Hortifrut acquisition.

commercial_position.rationale: Establishes the depth of the acquired programme.
